query: SELECT to_char(d.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "key!", NULL::text AS label, count(u.id) AS "requests!", count(u.id) FILTER (WHERE (u.prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL OR u.completion_tokens IS NOT NULL) AND NOT coalesce(u.estimated, false)) AS "reported!", count(u.id) FILTER (WHERE u.estimated) AS "estimated!", coalesce(sum(u.prompt_tokens),0)::bigint AS "prompt_tokens!", coalesce(sum(u.completion_tokens),0)::bigint AS "completion_tokens!", sum(u.cached_tokens)::bigint AS cached_tokens, sum(u.reasoning_tokens)::bigint AS reasoning_tokens FROM generate_series($1::date, $2::date, interval '1 day') AS d(day) LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.created_at >= d.day AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AND u.created_at < (d.day + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day
